title: Clarify rerun original cleanup wording
summary: Clarified CSV rerun lifecycle wording so the replace-final-output choice is distinguished from old-source handling after proof.
reason: Operators could read Original After Proof as an option to replace the original source directly. The UI now names that lifecycle decision as old-source handling and keeps deletion framed as a later cleanup decision.
behavior_before: CSV rerun controls and preflight text used Original After Proof/original-source wording, which made final output replacement and prior source cleanup handoff easy to conflate.
behavior_after: CSV rerun controls, policy summaries, blocked guidance, and preflight text use Old Source After Proof/old-source wording. No backend lifecycle or source deletion behavior changed.
rollback_plan: Revert the launch WebView wording changes, test expectation updates, refreshed summaries, and this change packet.
